meta.name: convex-setup-auth
meta.description: Sets up Convex auth, identity mapping, and access control. Use for login, auth providers, users tables, protected functions, or roles in a Convex app.

copy.tagline: 为 Convex 应用添加登录、权限和用户管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Convex 应用中需要实现用户认证和访问控制
copy.tagline_en: Add login, permissions, and user management to Convex apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to implement authentication and access control in a Convex app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你为 Convex 应用设置用户登录、身份验证和权限控制，包括选择认证提供商、配置后端函数保护用户数据。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Convex 应用添加登录功能、管理用户表、设置认证提供商（如 Clerk、Auth0）或保护后端函数时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Convex 应用设置 Clerk 认证。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成 Clerk 的配置步骤。

say.text: 添加一个受保护的后端函数，只允许登录用户访问。
say.note: Claude 会生成带身份验证检查的查询或变更函数。

say.text: 设置用户表并实现身份映射。
say.note: Claude 会创建用户存储逻辑（如果应用需要）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up user login, authentication, and access control for a Convex app, including choosing an auth provider, configuring protected backend functions, and managing user data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add login functionality, manage user tables, set up auth providers (e.g., Clerk, Auth0), or protect backend functions in a Convex app.

say_en.text: Help me set up Clerk authentication for my Convex app.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through Clerk configuration steps.

say_en.text: Add a protected backend function that only logged-in users can access.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a query or mutation with authentication checks.

say_en.text: Set up a users table and implement identity mapping.
say_en.note: Claude will create user storage logic if needed.
